summary: Fixed suite_selection_select's sentinel-domination defect across all 5 plan phases: the selector's multi-path aggregation is now compositional (the sentinel is a floor contributed by its own member, never a ceiling over the whole set), its two production call sites (Gate 8 narrowing in verify-deploy.sh, the Tier Justification check in validate-artifact.sh) are adapted to the new contract, plan-format.md's authoring contract documents the mixed-set case, the semantics are pinned with fixtures across three test suites, and the deployed tree has been regenerated with confirmed byte-for-byte source-store/deployed parity.
